headline: Congo’s FRN-M23 Rebels Plan 3,300 Houses to Ease Goma Housing Crisis
summary: A residential development of more than 3,000 houses is being planned outside Goma in eastern DRC, as housing pressure in the region continues to grow. The plan is linked to the FRN-M23 rebel group.
why: Goma is a major city in eastern Congo, a region with long-running conflict affecting mining and trade. Housing and construction activity there reflects the economic reach of armed groups that control territory.
